findings.title: CronJob replaces each run before it finishes
findings.cause: CronJob sync has concurrencyPolicy Replace and schedule "* * * * *", and its runs take longer than that: each new run deletes the one still going, so none finishes; it deleted 4 Jobs (sync-29925311, sync-29925312, sync-29925313, sync-29925314), and it has never completed a run

evidence.what: CronJob sync has concurrencyPolicy Replace and schedule "* * * * *", and Job sync-29925315 is active
evidence.command: kubectl get cronjob sync -n kd-cronjob-replace-never-finishes -o jsonpath='{.spec.schedule}{" "}{.spec.concurrencyPolicy}{" "}{.status}'

findings.fix: Make a run finish within the schedule's interval (its pods' logs show where the time goes), or space the schedule out beyond how long a run takes; concurrencyPolicy Forbid lets a run finish and skips the starts that overlap it.
